ask: make the Today screen in proto-clinic work like Linear's inbox (https://linear.app/docs/inbox) - just the flow, keep our look
notes: Reference by URL, the mode (flow only) and the target screen are all in the ask. A good intake states them and asks only what the reference leaves open (for example what the detail pane shows for an appointment).
message:
**Goal:** make the Today screen of Northside Physio work like Linear's inbox, flow only, in your own look.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML, no `dev` or `start` script. I will serve the folder locally. (from the folder)
- Reference: Linear's inbox docs page, https://linear.app/docs/inbox. I read it in the copy step and list every part of its flow first. (from your message)
- Mode: flow only. Same parts, order and steps; your colours, fonts, buttons and sample data stay. (from "just the flow, keep our look")
- Screen it changes: Today (the table of 5 appointments, with the 3 stat cards and "New appointment" above). (from your message)
- Look rules: no `CLAUDE.md` and no design skill installed, so I follow the prototype's own tokens (`--accent`, `--line`, 8px and 10px radii) and the built-in design check. (from the folder)
- Start check: Chrome and Node 25 are there, so screenshots work. Nothing is published, pushed or committed.

**Track:** full, because you asked to copy a reference.

**Coverage:** 5 clear · partial: Main flow, Edge cases, Words with no number · missing: none

**Done means:**
- Today follows every part of Linear's inbox flow, or says why one is left out.
- Fonts, colours and radii on Today match the "before" screenshots.
- Clients, Invoices and Settings look the same as before.
- Every row of `requests.md` is done, or left with a reason.
- The prototype's link answers 200.

Everything else (the needs table, request list, coverage table) goes in `loop-runs/product-design-loop-20261126-034052/brief.md` once you say go.

**My request list (my reading, you can correct any row):**
- R1 Today: appointments become inbox items. A list on the left, one open on the right, with the first one selected.
- R2 Today: a new item shows an unread dot and bold name. Opening it clears the dot.
- R3 Today: a "Done" action on an open item moves it out of the list into a "Done" tab (my reading of mark done).
- R4 Today: "Inbox" and "Done" tabs at the top of the list, each with a count.
- R5 Today: keyboard `J` and `K` move between items, `E` marks done.
- R6 Today: when the list is empty it shows "You're all caught up".
- R7 Today: keep the 3 stat cards, "New appointment" and the page title as they are.

**Not touched:** "New appointment" does nothing, the "Customers" title does not match the "Clients" tab, and Invoices has no empty state. They were like this before.

About 40 minutes and 3 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. What should "Done" mean for an appointment?
   Recommended: the client is checked in, and the row shows "Checked in".
   Why it matters: it sets the wording, the tab name and what the open item shows.
2. Which appointments start as unread?
   Recommended: Owen Brooks (First visit) only, because he is new.
   Why it matters: it decides what the unread state looks like on first open.
3. Should the state survive a page reload?
   Recommended: no, it resets on reload, because the prototype has no saved data.
   Why it matters: a person trying the flow twice sees the same start.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
